scripts.test: npm run build && npm run ui:build && node scripts/prepare-local-worker-env.mjs && wrangler dev --local --port 4111 --config .mastra/output/wrangler.json
scripts.ui:build: mkdir -p .mastra/output/studio && (cd ui && npm run build) && cp -r ui/dist/* .mastra/output/studio/
scripts.deploy: mastra build && npm run ui:build && wrangler deploy --config .mastra/output/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:dry-run: mastra build && npm run ui:build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config .mastra/output/wrangler.json
